source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 236 (positive X_k, F(0) = 0, gains and entrance fee, (7.10))
Feller vol. II p. 236 footnote 12 ((7.11) is convergence in probability)
components.note: The law, tails, closed and strict truncated moments, delta and rho with the q(s) = 0 convention, and the relative weak normalizer (convergence in probability) are defined; Feller's domain F(0) = 0 is identified and the atom-at-zero extension declared.

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 237 (integration by parts reduces E(X'^2) to an integral with integrand x[1-F(x)], which is o(mu(x)))
Feller vol. II p. 235 lemma (7.5) used in (7.13)
components.note: Both truncated-moment identities (by Tonelli and by the source's integration by parts), v <= s mu, the two-error bound, mu(s)/s -> 0 and v/(s mu) -> 0 are proved.

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 237 ((7.11) necessitates bounded a_{n+1}/a_n)
Feller vol. II p. 236 Theorem 2 constants a_n
components.note: Linear lower growth, a_n -> infinity, a_{n+1}/a_n -> 1 without monotonicity, uniqueness of scale and the comparison converse are proved.

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 236 proof (a): n mu(s)/s right continuous, left limits not exceeding right limits, s_n the lower bound of {n mu(s)/s <= 1}
Feller vol. II p. 236 (7.12)
components.note: Nonempty crossing set, finiteness, s_n > s_0, the exact equation n mu(s_n) = s_n, s_n >= n mu(s_0) and monotonicity in n are proved.

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 236 footnote 12 (mu varies slowly)
Feller vol. II pp. 282-284 VIII.9
components.note: Slow variation at infinity is defined and applied to the truncated mean.

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 236 footnote 12 (rho -> infinity iff mu varies slowly, citing VIII.9 Theorem 2)
Feller vol. II pp. 283-284 VIII.9 Theorem 2 (9.11)-(9.19), here specialized to U_1 = mu and V_0 = 1 - F
components.note: The footnote-12 equivalence is proved directly in both directions, together with the strict-endpoint version and atom limits; the selected locator is the specialization, and the general VIII.9 theorem is deferred in C014.

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 236 Theorem 2 (7.11)-(7.12) and proof (a)
Feller vol. II p. 237 (7.13)-(7.15), truncation at 2a_n, the 'any approach' step
components.note: Both directions follow Feller's route: sufficiency through the truncated second moment, necessity through positivity, the largest summand, truncation at 2a_n, subsequences and the passage to every real threshold (without monotone a_n).

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 236 (7.11) with a_n = n mu(s_n)
Feller vol. II p. 237 necessity argument
components.note: Characterization of all relative normalizers, both truncated centers, both tail counts, and the finite-mean and infinite-mean behaviour of s_n/n are proved.

source_locators: Feller vol. II p. 236 Theorem 2 hypotheses (independence, common F, positivity)
handbook-supplied worked laws
components.note: Point masses, the critical density x^{-2} with s_n ~ n log n, the alpha-stable-tail failure, the dependence countermodel and the zero law are computed and proved.

source_locators: Durrett p. 65 Example 2.2.15 Cauchy density
Durrett p. 65 Example 2.2.16 St. Petersburg law and its coin description
components.note: Cauchy laws with scale, the St. Petersburg masses, their coin realization and independent repetition are defined.

source_locators: Durrett p. 65 Example 2.2.15 tail asymptotic and the conclusion that no constants mu_n work
Durrett p. 65 forward reference (Exercise 3.3.6): S_n/n has the law of X_1
components.note: Normalization, the tail asymptotic with squeeze, infinite absolute mean, failure of every centering via the routed weak-law criterion, and the exact law of S_n/n by direct convolution are proved.

source_locators: Durrett p. 65 Example 2.2.16: the cutoff principle, b_n = 2^{m(n)}, conditions (i) and (ii)
Durrett p. 66: a_n = n m(n), K(n)/log n -> 0, K(n) <= log log n, S_n/(n log_2 n) -> 1
components.note: Every step of the source triangular-array route, the source's cutoff principle with its consequence b_n/n -> infinity, and an explicit simultaneous parameter choice are proved.

source_locators: Durrett p. 66: fair price log_2 n per play, 10 dollars at n = 1024, Nicolas Bernoulli 1713, 2^40 plays
Feller vol. II p. 236: fair games (vol. I ch. X), losing side, entrance fee depending on the number of trials
components.note: Feller's criterion calculation for this law, uniqueness against the array normalizer, the n = 1024 figures, both sources' price readings and paradox, Bernoulli's remark and the break-even count are supplied with the scale/expectation distinction.

Durrett pp. 65-66
